# Hello World

Welcome to **Woods'Blog**! 🎉

This is my first blog post. The reason for creating this blog is simple — **record** and **share**. Here, I'll share tech articles, life reflections, and daily musings.

---

## Why Write a Blog

Writing a blog means a few things to me:

1. **Knowledge Retention** — Write down what you learn to deepen understanding and make it easy to revisit later
2. **Help Others** — Your experience might help someone facing the same problem
3. **Improve Expression** — Writing is an extension of thinking; writing clearly means thinking clearly
4. **Leave a Trace** — Words on the internet are proof that you existed

---

## What This Blog Has

### 📝 Posts

Tech articles and life essays covering frontend development, tools, learning notes, and more. Each post supports Markdown rendering with code highlighting, tables, blockquotes, and more.

### 💬 Moments

Short daily notes similar to social media posts, supporting text and images. When I don't feel like writing a long article, I record my thoughts here.

### 🔍 Search

Real-time search across post titles, content, and tags to quickly find what interests you.

### 🏷️ Tags & Archive

Posts are organized by tags and can also be browsed by year, making it easy to look back at older content.

### 💬 Comments

A comment system based on GitHub Issues (Utterances), no backend server required.

### 🌙 Dark Mode

Light/dark theme toggle that follows your system preference or can be switched manually.

### 🌐 Multi-language

Supports both Chinese and English with synchronized content.

---

## Tech Stack

This blog is built entirely with frontend technologies as a pure static site:

| Tech | Purpose |
|------|------|
| [Nuxt 3](https://nuxt.com/) | Universal framework with SSR and static generation |
| [Vue 3](https://vuejs.org/) | Reactive UI framework |
| [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) | Utility-first CSS for rapid UI development |
| [Markdown-it](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it) | Markdown parsing and rendering |
| [Utterances](https://utteranc.es/) | GitHub Issues based comment system |
| [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/) | Static site hosting and deployment |

### Architecture Highlights

- **Pure Static** — All content stored as JSON files, built into static HTML at build time, no database needed
- **SSG** — Uses Nuxt 3's `nuxt generate` to produce static files for simple deployment
- **Responsive Design** — Built with Tailwind CSS, works on desktop and mobile
- **Internationalization** — Chinese and English content stored separately, loaded at runtime by language

---

## Open Source

This blog is open source, with the code hosted on GitHub. If you're interested in how it works, feel free to check out the source code or submit an issue.

---

*Thanks for reading, looking forward to your feedback!*
